final: WITH g AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS aq, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS ad FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON CAST(p.production_type_code AS TEXT) = CAST(pc.production_type_code AS TEXT) GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), o AS (SELECT AVG(ad) AS oa FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.aq) AS avg_units, AVG(g.ad) AS avg_diff, AVG(g.ad - o.oa) AS avg_diff_from_overall FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.ad > o.oa
